title: UK to US Shoe Size Converter
primaryKeyword: UK to US Shoe Size Converter
metaDescription: Convert UK shoe sizes to American (US) shoe sizes across adult and youth shoes with centimeter measurements and precise width guidelines.
directAnswer: Converting UK to US shoe sizes requires adding 0.5 to 1 size for men (a UK 9 corresponds to a US Men's 9.5 or 10) and adding 2 full sizes for women (a UK 6 equals a US Women's 8). Both systems use 1/3-inch increments, but US sizing starts with a higher baseline offset.

faq.question: What is a UK 8 in US shoe size?
faq.answer: A UK 8 in men's footwear is a US Men's 8.5 (or 9 in athletic brands like Nike), and in women's is a US Women's 10.

faq.question: How do UK and US shoe sizes compare for children?
faq.answer: Children's UK sizes are offset by approximately half a size from US kids' sizes up to youth size 13, after which adult scaling begins.

faq.question: Are UK shoe widths different from US shoe widths?
faq.answer: Yes, standard UK men's width is typically labeled 'F' (equivalent to US 'D'), and standard UK women's width is 'D' (equivalent to US 'B').
